title: Grateful Dead Live at Pittsburgh Civic Arena on 1973-09-24

ai_review.summary: Audience tape with generally good sound (aside from a muffled China>Rider patch); the Eyes‑Wharf Rat horn section and Keith’s fiery keyboards are the show’s high points.
ai_review.review: The GEMS audience recording captures a solid 1973 performance, though the jam between China Cat Sunflower and Rider suffers from an alternate muffled source that some listeners find distracting. Highlights include the horn‑driven Eyes > Wharf Rat sequence, a stomping “Greatest,” and Keith’s scorching keyboard work, while Half Step is noted as weak.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars and praise the musical performance despite a single recording flaw; detailed comments across five reviews allow a confident rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall clear and well‑balanced audience tape; occasional echoy ambience, but the China>Rider jam is sourced from a muffled alternate track that detracts from the flow.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > The Other One (Feelin' Groovy Jam)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid playing throughout with a strong horn‑driven second half; the only noticeable dip is the muffled China>Rider patch and a weaker Half Step, but the overall pacing feels tight despite lacking a Dark Star or Other One marathon.

band_member_comments.Keys: Keith is on fire, delivering scorching keyboard work that energizes the set.
